title: GSE executable exit/action-token causal transport feasibility
purpose: Determine whether full learned exit geometry tokens preserve executable structural state and physical exit identity across causal frames strongly enough to justify a relational event model.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only C01-C08 feasibility audit; zero training, new inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated geometry Teacher arrays.
Sealed pooled-token and fixed-summary baseline metrics.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and locally trained frozen outputs.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Use every sealed C01-C08 observation once. Use only same-traversal adjacent causal pairs; no resampling or deletion.

teacher.source: Sealed directed-exit identity, visibility, heading, opening width and vertical profile from the deduplicated dataset; junction/terminal episodes from the corrected causal Teacher.
teacher.use: Teacher identity is attached only after heading/width assignment for evaluation. Descriptor transport never receives identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Sealed exit_mask and exit_width_valid_mask; padded exit slots have identity -1 and never enter matching.
teacher.student_input: No student training or inference; replay sealed exit-token outputs only.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph is created. A later model may propose nodes, but edges remain execution-only.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies no gradients; only feasibility counts.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only sealed C01-C08 data, frozen predictions and two sealed baselines are read.

methods.main: Preserve each predicted exit token. Attach visible Teacher identity through the frozen heading-plus-width matching cost for scoring only, then associate adjacent-frame tokens using descriptor cosine alone. Separately measure the executable visible-exit cardinality upper bound for junction/terminal decisions.
methods.baseline: Sealed fixed five-dimensional change point and sealed per-frame mean/max pooled ActionSetNodeDetector.
methods.fallback: If action-set episode support or all-seed descriptor transport fails, stop this route and reconsider the representation before training.

acceptance.population: Exactly 80 worlds, 252430 frames, 188126 observations, 396913 visible tokens, 130080/41970 adjacent pairs and 3282/1136 decision episodes.
acceptance.teacher: C07-C08 executable-set decision macro-F1 and decision-episode support coverage are each at least 0.98.
acceptance.transport: Every seed has C07-C08 adjacent-frame visible-token identity precision and recall at least 0.98.
acceptance.baseline: The sealed pooled event model remains below its 0.995 trigger precision safety contract.
acceptance.system: All 80 source shard tree hashes match; zero optimizer/new inference/threshold selection/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE.

failure_policy: Any source, join, count, causal-pair, matching or isolation ambiguity fails closed; do not train or tune around it.
retention: Retain JSON/CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, raw log, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal as method-selection and paper evidence.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU read-only full shard verification and token transport audit
